text: The autofocus HTML attribute in the admin search box is removed as it can be confusing for screen readers.
suggestion_reason: The admin search box no longer renders with autofocus; check the visible form behavior.

text: django.contrib.postgres.fields.CIText mixin is deprecated.
suggestion_reason: Code importing or inheriting the deprecated CIText mixin needs review.

text: django.contrib.staticfiles.storage.ManifestStaticFilesStorage now has experimental support for replacing paths to JavaScript modules in import and export statements with their hashed counterparts. If you want to try it, subclass ManifestStaticFilesStorage and set the support_js_module_import_aggregation attribute to True.
suggestion_reason: The opt-in requires a ManifestStaticFilesStorage subclass and a named attribute in code.

text: QuerySet.prefetch_related now supports django.db.models.Prefetch objects with sliced querysets.
suggestion_reason: Prefetch with sliced querysets changes ORM data retrieval behavior.

text: Migrations now support serialization of enum.Flag objects.
suggestion_reason: Serialization of enum.Flag values is a migration-data behavior.

text: The new "assume_role" option is now supported in OPTIONS on PostgreSQL to allow specifying the session role.
suggestion_reason: The PostgreSQL session role is set through database connection OPTIONS.

text: Upstream support for MySQL 5.7 ends in October 2023. Django 4.2 supports MySQL 8 and higher.
suggestion_reason: MySQL 8 or later is a database deployment requirement.

text: The debug page now shows exception notes and fine-grained error locations on Python 3.11+.
suggestion_reason: The development debug page displays exception notes and error locations differently.

text: The django.contrib.gis.admin.OpenLayersWidget is removed.
suggestion_reason: References to the removed OpenLayersWidget class must change.

text: The undocumented django.contrib.admin.helpers.checkbox is removed.
suggestion_reason: Code using the removed admin.helpers.checkbox helper must change.

text: The django.db.models.enums.ChoicesMeta metaclass is renamed to ChoicesType.
suggestion_reason: Imports or references to the renamed metaclass need review.

text: django.views.decorators.debug.sensitive_variables and django.views.decorators.debug.sensitive_post_parameters can now be used with asynchronous functions.
suggestion_reason: The sensitive_variables and sensitive_post_parameters decorators now accept async functions.

text: The new django.db.models.aprefetch_related_objects function allows asynchronous prefetching of model instances.
suggestion_reason: The new asynchronous prefetch function is an interface for application code.

text: The new AdminSite.get_model_admin method returns an admin class for the given model class.
suggestion_reason: The new AdminSite.get_model_admin method is a Python interface.

text: The new offset argument of django.core.validators.StepValueValidator allows specifying an offset for valid values.
suggestion_reason: StepValueValidator gains an offset argument for code to pass.

text: QuerySet.update_or_create now supports the parameter create_defaults. As a consequence, any models that have a field named create_defaults that are used with an update_or_create() should specify the field in the lookup with create_defaults__exact.
suggestion_reason: update_or_create callers using a create_defaults field need a new lookup spelling.

text: The check keyword argument of CheckConstraint is deprecated in favor of condition.
suggestion_reason: CheckConstraint callers should replace the deprecated check keyword with condition.

text: GeoIP2.city now exposes the accuracy_radius and region_name values. In addition, the dma_code and region values are now exposed as metro_code and region_code, but the previous keys are also retained for backward compatibility.
suggestion_reason: GeoIP2.city return values gain keys; consuming code may use or inspect them.

text: Upstream support for PostgreSQL 12 ends in November 2024. Django 5.1 supports PostgreSQL 13 and higher.
suggestion_reason: PostgreSQL 13 or later is a database deployment requirement.

text: SimpleTestCase.assertURLEqual and django.test.SimpleTestCase.assertInHTML now add ": " to the msg_prefix. This is consistent with the behavior of other assertions.
suggestion_reason: The output message from two test assertions gains a colon and space.

text: django.contrib.sessions.backends.base.SessionBase and all built-in session engines now provide async API. The new asynchronous methods all have a prefixed names, e.g. aget(), akeys(), or acycle_key().
suggestion_reason: Session engines gain named asynchronous methods for code to call.

text: The SimpleTestCase.assertFormsetError() method is removed.
suggestion_reason: Calls to the removed assertFormsetError method must change.

text: LoginRequiredMiddleware respects the login_url and redirect_field_name values set via the django.contrib.auth.decorators.login_required decorator, but does not support setting login_url or redirect_field_name via the django.contrib.auth.mixins.LoginRequiredMixin.
suggestion_reason: The note describes which authentication redirect settings middleware respects.

text: django.db.models.expressions.RowRange now accepts positive integers for the start argument and negative integers for the end argument.
suggestion_reason: RowRange accepts additional numeric argument values in Python code.

text: The new HttpRequest.get_preferred_type method can be used to query the preferred media type the client accepts.
suggestion_reason: HttpRequest gains a method returning the client's preferred media type.

text: The makemigrations and migrate commands have a new Command.autodetector attribute for subclasses to override in order to use a custom autodetector class.
suggestion_reason: A management-command subclass can override the new autodetector attribute.

text: The new operation AlterConstraint is a no-op operation that alters constraints without dropping and recreating constraints in the database.
suggestion_reason: AlterConstraint changes how a migration alters a database constraint.

text: django.utils.safestring.SafeString now returns NotImplemented in __add__ for non-string right-hand side values. This aligns with the str addition behavior and allows __radd__ to be used if available.
suggestion_reason: SafeString.__add__ now returns NotImplemented for a non-string value.

text: The password validator classes now have a new method get_error_message(), which can be overridden in subclasses to customize the error messages.
suggestion_reason: Password-validator subclasses can override the new get_error_message method.

text: The new django.db.models.functions.JSONArray database function accepts a list of field names or expressions and returns a JSON array containing those values.
suggestion_reason: JSONArray changes the values returned by a database expression.

text: Oracle backends now support connection pools, by setting "pool" in the OPTIONS part of your database configuration.
suggestion_reason: Oracle connection pooling is enabled through database OPTIONS.

text: The all argument for the django.contrib.staticfiles.finders.find() function is deprecated in favor of the find_all argument.
suggestion_reason: Callers of staticfiles.find should replace all with find_all.

text: The new django.db.models.AnyValue aggregate returns an arbitrary value from the non-null input values. This is supported on SQLite, MySQL, Oracle, and PostgreSQL 16+.
suggestion_reason: AnyValue changes the values produced by an ORM aggregate query.

text: The Django Template Language now supports template partials, making it easier to encapsulate and reuse small named fragments within a template file. The new tags {% partialdef %} and {% partial %} define a partial and render it, respectively.
suggestion_reason: Template partials change what fragments a template can render.

text: Upstream support for MariaDB 10.5 ends in June 2025. Django 6.0 supports MariaDB 10.6 and higher.
suggestion_reason: MariaDB 10.6 or later is a database deployment requirement.

text: The get_prefetch_queryset() method of related managers and descriptors is removed.
suggestion_reason: Code using the removed get_prefetch_queryset method needs review.

text: The PostgreSQL StringAgg class is deprecated in favor of the generally available django.db.models.StringAgg class.
suggestion_reason: Imports or uses of PostgreSQL StringAgg should move to the general class.

text: Multiple Cookie headers are now supported for HTTP/2 requests when running with ASGI.
suggestion_reason: The change concerns HTTP/2 Cookie handling in an ASGI deployment.

text: Message levels messages.DEBUG and messages.INFO now have distinct icons and CSS styling. Previously, both levels shared the same appearance as messages.SUCCESS. Given that ModelAdmin.message_user uses messages.INFO by default, set the level to messages.SUCCESS to keep the previous icon and styling.
suggestion_reason: Admin message levels have different icons and CSS styling.

text: The new BaseGeometryWidget.base_layer attribute allows specifying a JavaScript map base layer, enabling customization of map tile providers.
suggestion_reason: The geometry widget's map base layer changes visible map tiles.

text: Fixed a regression in Django 6.0 where django.urls.path routes defined using django.utils.translation.gettext_lazy failed to resolve correctly (36796).
suggestion_reason: Code defining translated path routes is the affected interface.

text: Fixed a regression in Django 5.2 that caused improper values to be returned from QuerySet.values_list() when duplicate field names were specified (36288).
suggestion_reason: values_list returned an incorrect value shape for duplicate field names.

text: Fixed a regression in Django 5.2.1 that prevented the usage of UNNEST PostgreSQL strategy of QuerySet.bulk_create() with foreign keys (36502).
suggestion_reason: The fix changes ORM bulk_create behavior for foreign keys.

text: Fixed a regression in Django 5.2 that caused a crash when using QuerySet.prefetch_related() to prefetch a foreign key with a Prefetch queryset for a subclass of the foreign target (36432).
suggestion_reason: The fix changes ORM prefetch behavior for a foreign-key relationship.

text: QuerySet.filter, QuerySet.exclude, QuerySet.get, and Q were subject to SQL injection using a suitably crafted dictionary, with dictionary expansion, as the _connector argument.
suggestion_reason: Untrusted dictionary expansion into named ORM methods is the code path to check.

text: Fixed a regression in Django 5.2, introduced when fixing 2025-26699, where the wordwrap template filter did not preserve empty lines between paragraphs after wrapping text (36341).
suggestion_reason: The wordwrap template filter changes the rendered text's blank lines.

text: Fixed a crash when using select_related against a ForeignObject originating from a model with a CompositePrimaryKey (36373).
suggestion_reason: select_related with a composite primary key affects ORM data retrieval.

text: Fixed a regression in Django 5.2 that caused a crash when using QuerySet.select_for_update(of=(…)) with values()/values_list() including expressions (36301).
suggestion_reason: select_for_update with expressions changes ORM query behavior.

text: Fixed a regression in Django 5.2 that caused a crash when using update() on a QuerySet filtered against a related model and including references to annotations through values() (36360).
suggestion_reason: The fix concerns ORM update queries with related-model filters and annotations.

text: Fixed a regression in Django 5.2 where the password validation error message from MinimumLengthValidator was not translated when using non-English locales (36314).
suggestion_reason: Password-validation error text is now translated for non-English locales.
